{{Top|leg}}
'''Flamestriker armor''' was the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by the [[Flamestrike Legion]]. It was mustard-yellow and was equipped with internal [[Targeting sensor/Legends|targeting sensors]]. [[Norjax Thall]] continued to wear his Flamestriker armor after the Legion was forcibly disbanded.
